Rank 4 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: 75 Ki
  • Prerequisites: None
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: 300 Feet (30 foot radius)
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Blast

The explosive move of the legendary Broly, throw a marble sized energy blast that slowly grows before impact. Choose a location within range, all creatures within a 30 foot radius must make a Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10d8 Ki Damage on a fail, half on a success.
